'''CLL unofficial''' (colloquially, '''UnCLL''', '''InCLL''', '''ILG-CLL''') is a project by [[la gleki]] of regular experimental unofficial (not necessarily approved by [[LLG]]) builds of the [[CLL|Complete Lojban Language]] book.
